text: Remember, Rome wasn't built in a day.
All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
If a job is worth doing, it is worth doing well.
A job well begun is half done.
A bad workman always blames his tools.
Always strike while the iron is hot.
Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.
Elbow grease is the best polish.
Hard work never did anyone any harm.
Don't cross the bridge until you come to it.
Always measure twice and cut once.
Slow and steady wins the race.
Where there's a will, there's a way.
The squeaky wheel gets the grease.
A chain is only as strong as its weakest link.
Two heads are better than one.
Jack of all trades, master of none.
You must learn to walk before you run.
If you want something done right, do it yourself.
Don't bite off more than you can chew.
Plan your work and work your plan.
Always put business before pleasure.
All things are difficult before they are easy.
You only get out what you put in.
A good beginning makes a good ending.
Necessity is the mother of invention.
Little by little does the trick.
Constant dropping wears away the stone.
Keep your nose to the grindstone.
You should practice what you preach.
Great talkers are little doers.
The devil finds work for idle hands to do.
Money doesn't grow on trees, you know.
A fool and his money are soon parted.
Take care of the pennies and the pounds will take care of themselves.
Cut your coat according to your cloth.
Don't spend what you don't have.
Money can't buy you happiness.
In the end, you get what you pay for.
Don't be penny wise and pound foolish.
If you buy cheap, you buy twice.
He who pays the piper calls the tune.
Don't throw good money after bad.
Money is a good servant but a bad master.
You should always live within your means.
A light purse is a heavy curse.
You can't take it with you when you go.
Time and tide wait for no man.
All good things must come to an end.
Time flies when you're having fun.
There's no time like the present.
Haste makes waste, so take your time.
The more haste, the less speed.
Just take it one day at a time.
Better an hour too early than a minute too late.
There is a time and a place for everything.
You can't turn back the clock.
Better late than never, but better never late.
You are never too old to learn.
Experience is the best teacher.
Two wrongs don't make a right.
Ask no questions and hear no lies.
It's better to be safe than sorry.
There's no fool like an old fool.
A wise man changes his mind; a fool never does.
Hindsight is always twenty-twenty.
A problem shared is a problem halved.
You learn something new every day.
Wise men learn by other men's mistakes; fools by their own.
The wise man does at once what the fool does at last.
Ask a silly question and you get a silly answer.
There is no royal road to learning.
It's easy to be wise after the event.
A word to the wise is sufficient.
Believe nothing of what you hear and only half of what you see.
A fool may ask more questions in an hour than a wise man can answer in seven years.
What you don't know can't hurt you.
Better to ask the way than go astray.
You should always look before you leap.
To be forewarned is to be forearmed.
Hope for the best, but prepare for the worst.
Don't burn your bridges behind you.
Better the devil you know than the devil you don't.
If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
It's best to leave well enough alone.
It is better to bend than to break.
Don't trouble trouble until trouble troubles you.
Never judge a man until you have walked a mile in his shoes.
Don't make a mountain out of a molehill.
Don't wash your dirty linen in public.
Better to have it and not need it than need it and not have it.
Better to light a candle than to curse the darkness.
Honesty is always the best policy.
The truth will always come out in the end.
Cheaters never win and winners never cheat.
A lie has no legs to stand on.
An honest man's word is as good as his bond.
Tell the truth and shame the devil.
A liar should have a good memory.
A clear conscience is a soft pillow.
Say what you mean and mean what you say.
Give credit where credit is due.
Never promise more than you can perform.
A man is only as good as his word.
Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
Empty vessels make the most noise.
Always think before you speak.
The least said, the soonest mended.
Sticks and stones may break my bones, but words will never hurt me.
A word spoken is past recalling.
If you can't say anything nice, don't say anything at all.
It's not what you say, it's how you say it.
Keep your mouth shut and your eyes open.
Many a true word is spoken in jest.
That is easier said than done.
Don't tell tales out of school.
Hear no evil, see no evil, speak no evil.
A still tongue makes a wise head.
It's not what you know but who you know.
Self-praise is no recommendation.
The bigger they are, the harder they fall.
Don't get too big for your boots.
Don't let success go to your head.
Even a stopped clock is right twice a day.
You win some and you lose some.
It's not whether you win or lose, it's how you play the game.
Failure is the mother of success.
You should never rest on your laurels.
A winner never quits and a quitter never wins.
Nothing is impossible to a willing heart.
He who laughs last laughs longest.
You should quit while you're ahead.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Whatever goes up must come down.
Better to have tried and failed than never to have tried at all.
When the going gets tough, the tough get going.
It's a long road that has no turning.
Never give up and never give in.
When one door closes, another opens.
There's light at the end of the tunnel.
If you can't beat them, join them.
There is no gain without pain.
Where there is life, there is hope.
It is better to wear out than to rust out.
Make the most of what you have.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
It's first come, first served.
One man's loss is another man's gain.
Make the best of a bad situation.
You have to take the rough with the smooth.
All that glitters is not gold.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
Appearances are often deceiving.
The clothes do not make the man.
Handsome is that handsome does.
A man is judged by his deeds, not his words.
First impressions are the most lasting.
Things are not always what they seem.
Every man is innocent until proven guilty.
The exception proves the rule.
There are two sides to every story.
Six of one and half a dozen of the other.
It takes all sorts to make a world.
There's no accounting for taste.
It is the thought that counts.
What goes around comes around in the end.
One good turn deserves another.
You can't please everyone all the time.
One man's trash is another man's treasure.
There is no smoke without fire.
